transports.description: Slack MCP server (stdio). Requires SLACK_BOT_TOKEN and SLACK_TEAM_ID.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List public channels in the Slack workspace.

tools.name: get_channel_history
tools.description: Retrieve message history from a Slack channel.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Post a message to a Slack channel or thread. Gates through TLA confirmation before sending.

tools.name: get_thread_replies
tools.description: Get all replies in a Slack message thread.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search Slack messages across the workspace by keyword.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List users in the Slack workspace.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get profile details for a specific Slack user.

configurableProperties.label: Slack Bot Token
configurableProperties.description: Slack bot OAuth token (xoxb-...). Generated from your Slack app's OAuth & Permissions page.

configurableProperties.label: Slack Team ID
configurableProperties.description: Slack workspace/team ID (e.g. T01234ABCD). Found in workspace settings or via Slack API.

checks: build: npm install && npm run build
trust.notes: Community Slack MCP server. Uses Slack Web API via bot token. send_message triggers real outbound messages to workspace members — gates through TLA confirmation. Read-only tools (list_channels, get_history, search) require only `channels:read` and `channels:history` scopes.
trust.securityNotes: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN stored as dmcp secret. Scope bot token to minimum Slack OAuth scopes: channels:read, channels:history, chat:write (only if send_message needed), users:read. send_message is irreversible in a Slack workspace context — TLA gate mandatory.
